name: doodad-snap-custom-more
description: Snap Doodads on Load, other game textures (1x1, 8x8, 16x16, 2x1, 4x1, _) for doodads and fixed rotations (bfxr 90, -1, 270, 0 on _, 2x2, 1x1, 4x4, 2x1) for destructables, each at two angles (make-doodad-snap.mjs more); matches but D104 (4x1Default, a picture one pixel high): the editor puts its x at q=0 and y at q=1 on the 64 grid (-256, -448 for -286.5, -478.75), Studio on the 32n+16 one (-304, -496); not understood, see bugs.md

steps.eval: const s = await w3.services.get('w3.terrain'); for (let i = 0; i < 60 && !s.placedObjects()?.doodads?.length; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); window.__driveEd.pushEdit({ undo() {}, redo() {}, terrain: false, objects: false });
